FAQs

Got questions?
We’ve got answers.

Solutions & applications
Capabilities & customization
Service & support
Quality & compliance
Innovation & R&D
Solutions & applications
  • What do you make?
    Specialty excipients and functional polymer systems for oral solid dosage and liquid orals, covering enteric/targeted release, sustained/controlled release, taste masking, protective films, film-forming/binding, and rheology modification.
  • Which product families are available?
    DRUGCOAT® (functional methacrylic systems for enteric/sustained/taste protection), DRCOAT® (film-coating systems), AQUAPOL® (rheology modifiers for viscosity/flow), APION® (ion-exchange resins for tablet disintegration and taste masking in syrups/suspensions).
  • Where are they used?
    Across tablets, capsules, pellets/multiparticulates, and liquid orals (syrups/suspensions) to improve stability, palatability, processability, and release behaviour.
  • In what forms are materials supplied?
    Typically powders, aqueous dispersions, and organic solutions, matched to your equipment and process.
    • Capabilities & customization
  • Can you tailor materials to my API and process?
    Yes, options include solvent system, viscosity/solids, particle size, film properties, and target pH trigger/permeability (where applicable).
  • What do you need to start a custom request?
    Your release or processing goal, process parameters, equipment details, and constraints (e.g., solvents, temperature, regulatory).
  • Do you guide on pigments, plasticizers, and process aids?
    Yes, compatibility guidance for plasticizers, pigments/opacity, anti-tack to ensure consistent films.
  • Can you propose alternatives to incumbent materials?
    We assess functional needs and process fit to recommend a safe transition plan.
    • Service & support
  • How do I request a sample?
    Use Ask for Sample with brief application details; we respond with a best-fit recommendation and next steps.
  • Do you support trials and scale-up?
    Yes, screening advice, trial batches, parameter ranges, and equipment fit to de-risk commercialization.
  • Is troubleshooting available during evaluation?
    Yes, support for defect resolution, film formation, and process optimization.
  • Do you ship internationally?
    Yes, global shipments with coordinated export documentation and clear timelines.
    • Quality & compliance
  • How do you ensure consistent international quality?
    Through defined international quality systems, validated methods, and full traceability from raw material to release.
  • Is every batch tested before dispatch?
    Yes, batch-wise release testing against approved specifications.
  • Can partners review your systems?
    Yes, partner audits/reviews can be scheduled with our quality team.
  • How are changes communicated?
    Via a formal change-control process with advance notification and supporting records.
    • Innovation & R&D
  • How does your R&D help my project?
    We work with your team to understand the goal, run small trials, and share settings that make the process work on your equipment.
  • What happens after I send a brief?
    We review your API and process, suggest a plan, pick the right materials, and give you a simple trial outline with timelines.
  • Do you run trials before full scale?
    Yes, lab and pilot trials. We test small batches, check film quality and how the dose releases, then tune and confirm.
  • What data will I receive?
    Clear test results (e.g., release curve, film strength, moisture checks, viscosity) plus a one-page summary of recommended settings.
